snippet.title: SHOCK - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
ANNOUNCEMENT: Welcome to SHOCK

War changes people. But what if the truth is far worse than you remember?

SHOCK is a psychological survival horror game where you step into the wheels of Jack River—a disabled war veteran trapped in an abandoned parking lot, pursued by something unnatural. With no way to fight back, every movement counts. But as you struggle to survive, one question lingers:

Are you really the hero you think you are?

This is fear. This is survival. This is SHOCK.
